raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Enable #63106's cross-stage cache relay on the ROCm DeepSeek-V4.1 path, so PP can cut inside a KV-sharing group and balance the stages under decoder SWA bounded replay. Stacked on #63106, #64051 and #64642.

## Claims

- On MI355X, PP2 × TP1 with `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=10,30` or `11,29` serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; before this PR these cuts are refused ("PP splits inside a v4.1 kv-sharing group are not supported").
- Prefill throughput at concurrency ≥ 8 per instance: **1.29–1.41x TP2 + replay** on the same GPUs, **1.12–1.15x the best cut supported today (8/32)**.
- GSM8K and needle-in-a-haystack match TP2 within run-to-run noise.

## Validation

One MI355X node, four 2-GPU instances (TP2, PP2 8/32, 10/30, 11/29) loaded side by side and measured one at a time while the other three idle; two loads with the configs on different GPU pairs, two rounds per load (instance order reversed). `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, replay on, Engram CPU offload, MXFP4 indexer, `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`, no prefix caching, breakable CUDA graphs. Prefill-only load (`--random-output-len 1`).

<details>
<summary>Server and client commands</summary>

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_SPARSE_MLA=1 VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 \
VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=10,30 \
vllm serve /models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 --trust-remote-code \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --tensor-parallel-size 1 --pipeline-parallel-size 2 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --moe-backend aiter \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}' \
  --block-size 128 --language-model-only --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384

vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model dsv41 --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 16384 --random-output-len 1 --random-range-ratio 0 \
  --num-prompts 64 --max-concurrency 16 --ignore-eos
```

</details>

**Input throughput** (K tok/s per instance, median; main cells n=4, sweep cells n=2; spread within a cell < 2%):

| Input / concurrency | TP2 | PP2 8/32 (today's best) | PP2 10/30 | PP2 11/29 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 8K / 1 | 49.0 | 37.8 (0.77x) | 37.8 (0.77x) | 37.7 (0.77x) |
| 8K / 4 | 59.7 | 63.6 (1.07x) | 65.1 (1.09x) | 65.3 (1.09x) |
| 8K / 8 | 62.0 | 71.4 (1.15x) | 79.9 (1.29x) | 81.4 (1.31x) |
| 8K / 16 | 62.4 | 74.0 (1.19x) | 83.7 (1.34x) | 85.4 (1.37x) |
| 16K / 16 | 62.6 | 76.3 (1.22x) | 86.8 (1.39x) | 86.5 (1.38x) |
| 32K / 16 | 62.2 | 76.5 (1.23x) | 87.5 (1.41x) | 87.7 (1.41x) |

Median TTFT at 16K / 16: TP2 4160 ms, 8/32 3354 ms, 10/30 2923 ms.

**Stage balance** (GPU compute ms per 8K tokens, torch profiler, NCCL excluded): 8/32 66.7 / 109.7, 10/30 81.9 / 94.1, 11/29 89.9 / 86.2. The relay's copy kernels take ~15 µs per step per stage; the relayed rows add ~2.7 KB per token to the ~40 KB hc hidden state.

**Accuracy** (GSM8K, first 400 test questions, 8-shot, greedy, same session):

| Config | GSM8K | Discordant vs TP2 (TP2-only / config-only) | McNemar p |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
| TP2 | 0.9225 | — | — |
| PP2 10/30 | 0.910 | 13 / 8 | 0.38 |
| PP2 11/29 | 0.910 | 15 / 10 | 0.42 |
| PP2 8/32 | 0.910 | 14 / 9 | 0.40 |
| TP2, a separate launch | 0.915 | 13 / 10 | 0.68 |

Needle-in-a-haystack (~7.2K tokens, 3 depths): 3/3 for every config on both loads.

**Tests**

- `tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer.py::test_pipeline_relay_round_trips_preshuffled_keys`: aiter's K store fills preshuffled pages; the gather must equal the natural-order rows and the scatter must rebuild the pool byte for byte. Passes for 64- and 128-entry pages.
- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_amd_pp_replay.py::test_pp_partition_matches_default_cut[10,30]`: greedy logprobs of the 10/30 cut against the default 20/20 cut, decode on CUDA graphs.

```text
tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer.py -k pipeline_relay: 2 passed, 33 deselected
tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_amd_pp_replay.py::test_pp_partition_matches_default_cut[14,26] PASSED
tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_amd_pp_replay.py::test_pp_partition_matches_default_cut[10,30] PASSED
```

**GPU syncs**: a 10/30 server and a TP2 server under `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=warn`, same load (needle, 64 × 8K-in/64-out requests at concurrency 16, 100 GSM8K questions; no failed requests). The only sync either reports is one, once, on the 10/30 server: `indexer.py:1089` (`torch.tensor(dcp_rank, device=...)` in the indexer builder's `__init__`), reached from `model_state._prepare_replay_batch` → `_copy_attn_groups` when the replay batch builds its own metadata builders on its first step. That is the existing replay code, not this PR's; the relay adds no sync site, and nothing syncs in steady state. Under `=error` that one-time construction stops the server on its first prefill, so the check was run in `warn` mode.

## Details

- `RocmPipelineRelay` subclasses #63106's `PipelineRelay`. The compressed main KV has the 584 B record the shared `copy_pipeline_cache_rows` reads. aiter writes the MXFP4 indexer K pages preshuffled for its MQA-logits kernel (`[chunk, token, byte]` runs and lane-major scales), so `copy_rocm_mxfp4_index_rows` uses the offsets of aiter's `k_norm_rope_mxfp4_cache`, with the page geometry from `rocm_paged_mxfp4_cache_layout`.
- `DeepseekV41ROCMAiterMLAAttention` consumers memoize their ragged top-k on the index source's module, which on the receiving stage is the relayed replica. The replica never runs, and the relay is captured inside the breakable CUDA graph, so the stage's first consumer of the relayed source refreshes the memos instead: its attention runs eagerly at replay, as the index source's own refresh does.
- Scope: a cut must keep its index source equal to its KV source and come before the candidate source (layer 20). Replay already requires the stage holding layer 20 to hold every later layer, so this covers every cut that balances a replay prefill. Other cuts are refused at startup.
- Shared code: `copy_pipeline_cache_rows` passes `launch_pdl` only on CUDA, as the other kernels in that file do.
- Tradeoffs: the receiving stage holds the relayed source's caches, so the KV pool shrinks with the cut (per instance: TP2 44.1M, 8/32 9.95M, 10/30 16.4M, 11/29 19.7M tokens). At concurrency 1–2 PP2 stays slower than TP2 (0.75–0.77x) whatever the cut; this targets throughput-bound prefill.
- `RocmPipelineRelay.transfer` repeats the base loop to pick the copy per cache; a per-cache hook in `PipelineRelay` would remove that if #63106 prefers it.
- CI: the kernel test's file is CDNA4-only, and its `kernels/attention` step runs on MI300, so the relay case is added to the `:amd: (MI355) DeepSeek-V4.1 Mono Decode Numerics` step (mi355_4, optional) with the model test.

+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops.fused_compress_quant_cache import (
+        copy_pipeline_cache_rows,
+    )

+    block_size = 32
+    num_blocks = math.ceil(num_tokens / block_size) + 1
+    stride = block_size * row_bytes + 256

+    source_slots = torch.arange(num_tokens + 1, device="cuda")[1:]
+    source_slots[::5] = -1
+    # Match valid rows, while using a different physical location on the receiver.
+    target_slots = torch.where(source_slots >= 0, source_slots + block_size, -1)
+    rows = torch.empty((num_tokens + 1, row_bytes), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)[
+        1:

+        copy_pipeline_cache_rows(
+            source,
+            rows,
+            positions,
+            source_slots,
+            compress_ratio,
+            value_bytes,
+            scatter=False,
+        )
+        copy_pipeline_cache_rows(
+            target,
+            rows,
+            positions,
+            target_slots,
+            compress_ratio,
+            value_bytes,
+            scatter=True,
+        )
+
+    relay()
+    if use_graph:
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            relay()
+        source_backing.bitwise_xor_(1)
+        source_cpu.bitwise_xor_(1)
+        target_backing.fill_(5)
+        graph.replay()
+    expected_rows = torch.zeros((num_tokens, row_bytes), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    expected_target = torch.full_like(source_cpu, 5)
+    byte = torch.arange(row_bytes)

+            expected_target[dst // block_size, offsets(dst)] = expected_rows[token]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(rows.cpu(), expected_rows)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(target_backing.cpu(), expected_target)

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Cross-stage cache relay on the ROCm caches.
+
+The compressed main KV keeps the record the shared relay copies. aiter writes
+the MXFP4 indexer K pages preshuffled for its MQA-logits kernel, so those rows
+are gathered and scattered in that order instead.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops.fused_compress_quant_cache import (
+    copy_pipeline_cache_rows,
+)
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer import (
+    MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE,
+    rocm_paged_mxfp4_cache_layout,
+)
+
+from ..nvidia.pipeline import PipelineBoundary, PipelineRelay
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+    from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+
+
+class RocmPipelineRelay(PipelineRelay):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str,
+        incoming: PipelineBoundary,
+        outgoing: PipelineBoundary,
+    ):
+        for boundary in (incoming, outgoing):
+            # The candidate pool is not relayed, and ROCm consumers look their
+            # top-k memos up under the index source's name.
+            if boundary.candidate_source is not None or (
+                boundary.index_source != boundary.kv_source
+            ):
+                raise NotImplementedError(
+                    "DeepSeek-V4.1 on ROCm relays caches only across cuts whose "
+                    "index source is their KV source, at or before the last KV "
+                    "source layer."
+                )
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, prefix, incoming, outgoing)
+        self.index_heads = self.config.index_n_heads
+        self.index_head_dim = self.config.index_head_dim
+        if self.main_cache is not None:
+            # The relayed source stands in for the index source whose ragged
+            # top-k memos DeepseekV41ROCMAiterMLAAttention's consumers share.
+            self.main_cache._topk_ragged_cache = {}
+            self.main_cache._prefill_topk_ragged_cache = {}
+
+    def configure_consumers(self, layers) -> None:
+        """Have the stage's first consumer of the relayed index source refresh
+        its memos each step: that consumer's attention runs eagerly under the
+        breakable CUDA graph, unlike this relay."""
+        if self.main_cache is None:
+            return
+        source = f"{self.prefix}.layers.{self.incoming.index_source}.attn"
+        for layer in layers:
+            if getattr(layer.attn, "_index_source_prefix", None) == source:
+                layer.attn._refreshes_relayed_index_source = True

+def get_pipeline_boundaries(

+    num_layers = config.num_hidden_layers

+        not stage_ranges

+        or stage_ranges[-1][1] != num_layers
+        or any(start >= end for start, end in stage_ranges)
+        or any(a[1] != b[0] for a, b in zip(stage_ranges, stage_ranges[1:]))
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("DeepSeek-V4.1 pipeline stages must partition all layers")
+    ratios = config.compress_ratios
+    if len(ratios) < num_layers or any(r not in (0, 1, 2) for r in ratios):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid DeepSeek-V4.1 compress_ratios")
+    sources = {}
+    for kind, field in (
+        ("kv", "kv_source_layer_ids"),
+        ("index", "index_source_layer_ids"),
+    ):
+        values = tuple(getattr(config, field, ()) or ())

+            values != tuple(sorted(set(values)))

+            prefix = f"{self.prefix}.layers.{source}.attn"
+            yield (
+                f"pp_main_kv_{source}",
+                prefix,
+                self.main_row_bytes,
+                (576 if self.main_row_bytes == 584 else self.main_row_bytes),
+            )
+            yield (
+                f"pp_index_k_{source}",
+                f"{prefix}.indexer.k_cache",
+                self.index_row_bytes,
+                128 if self.index_row_bytes == 132 else 64,
+            )
+
+    def empty_tensors(
+        self, boundary: PipelineBoundary, batch_size: int, device: torch.device
+    ) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        tensors = {
+            key: torch.zeros((batch_size, width), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+            for key, _, width, _ in self._cache_entries(boundary)
+        }
+        if boundary.index_source is not None:
+            tensors["pp_topk"] = torch.full(
+                (batch_size, self.config.index_topk),
+                -1,
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+                device=device,
+            )
+        if boundary.candidate_source is not None:
+            tensors["pp_candidates"] = torch.full(
+                (batch_size, self.config.candidate_topk_blocks),
+                -1,
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+                device=device,
+            )
+        return tensors
+
+    def transfer(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        topk: torch.Tensor,
+        candidates: torch.Tensor | None,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+    ) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops.fused_compress_quant_cache import (
+            copy_pipeline_cache_rows,
+        )
+
+        importing = intermediate_tensors is not None
+        boundary = self.incoming if importing else self.outgoing
+        if intermediate_tensors is not None:
+            tensors = intermediate_tensors.tensors
+        else:
+            tensors = self.empty_tensors(boundary, positions.numel(), positions.device)
+        context = get_forward_context()
+        metadata = context.attn_metadata
+        if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not metadata:
+            return tensors
+        for key, prefix, _, value_bytes in self._cache_entries(boundary):
+            copy_pipeline_cache_rows(
+                self.context[prefix].kv_cache,
+                tensors[key],
+                positions,
+                cast(Any, metadata[prefix]).slot_mapping,
+                self.config.compress_ratios[boundary.kv_source],
+                value_bytes,
+                scatter=importing,
+            )
+        for key, buffer in (("pp_topk", topk), ("pp_candidates", candidates)):
+            if key in tensors:
+                assert buffer is not None
+                if importing:
+                    buffer[: positions.numel()].copy_(tensors[key])
+                else:
+                    tensors[key].copy_(buffer[: positions.numel()])
+        return tensors
